name: Ciphertel
summary: WA licensed carrier and ISP (fixed wireless, microwave and fibre) serving regional Western Australia; Bunbury-based, registered 2002 as Gateway Internet Services and trading as Ciphertel from 2016; still active (CIPHERTEL PTY LTD, ACN 101 635 563).

events.details: CIPHERTEL PTY LTD ACN 101 635 563 (ABN 59 101 635 563) active from 8 Aug 2002, Bunbury WA 6230; registered business name GATEWAY INTERNET SERVICES from the same date (8 Aug 2002), with the CIPHERTEL business name added 23 Jun 2016. Later a licensed WA carrier ISP.
source: https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=59101635563 (ABN active 08 Aug 2002; business names GATEWAY INTERNET SERVICES from 08 Aug 2002, CIPHERTEL from 23 Jun 2016; WA 6230)

events.details: Holds the former Bunbury Internet Service /21 (203.18.248.0-203.18.255.255, the 1997 BUNBURYINT-AU block): APNIC whois netname CIPHERTEL-NON-AU, Unit 3/9 Bourke Street, Bunbury WA 6230, network object registered 4 Sep 2008. UNCERTAIN whether this was an acquisition of Bunbury Internet Service or a pivot of the same business under the Ciphertel name; the block transfer is the documented evidence.
